q1_issues.issue: The four coordinated objects are stacked as four Theme atoms on one Skolem event, whereas the instruction set makes coordinated noun phrases distributive by default — the whole predication replicated once per conjunct, one event each.

"from down the coast" is reduced to (From $x sk_coast_1), silently dropping "down" and widening the origin to the coast at large, where the multi-word-preposition convention would join the whole preposition run into one head.

q2_gaps: Distributing a coordinated direct-object list inside a generic rule's conclusion: the Skolem-function event term (sk_bring $x) yields exactly one event per binding, and the instruction set gives no licensed way to mint one event per coordinated conjunct there.
notes: The generic-rule route, the 0.9/0.9 bare-generic truth value, bare-kind object fillers, Goal for "to the market", and top-level typing of the premise's sk_coast_1 constant are all correct; no QuantifierPhrase companion is right for a bare generic.
